name: FloorStaking stake/unstake supply accounting
summary: FloorStaking transferred a stake into its FLOOR balance before rebase() calculated balance minus circulating supply as distributable profit. An attacker could therefore have borrowed principal counted as reward, mint gFLOOR at the old index, trigger the resulting index increase during unstake(), and redeem at the new index for more FLOOR.
notes: The direct FloorStaking runtime containing the principal-as-profit rebase accounting was installed by this top-level contract creation.
After repaying the FLOOR flash loan and swapping the 14,606.145072279 FLOOR surplus, the exploit receipt records exactly 40.146353823753349478 WETH leaving the DAO-owned FLOOR/WETH pool.
